SHARKSTUDIES

THE COLLECTION / 作品目录

同一个灵感，
不断变化的形状。

鲨鱼是贯穿这组课程作品的线索。从轮廓、骨架到可活动的装置，每一次制作都在探索材料如何承载一个想法。

One recurring shape, five material conversations. A collection of objects exploring how a shark can be assembled, connected, enclosed and brought into motion.

01骨架 / Structure ↗02连接 / Connection ↗03容器 / Enclosure ↗04缠绕 / Texture ↗05咬合 / Motion ↗
01

STRUCTURE / 结构

Inside the shape.
让轮廓长出骨架

WOOD / INTERLOCKING
＋

OBSERVATION 01

空隙也是
形体的一部分。

纵向的脊柱与横向的肋片相互咬合。木片之间的留白，让鲨鱼的体积在轻盈的结构里浮现。

A spine meets a sequence of ribs. The spaces between wooden planes become as expressive as the material itself.

木片插接体积
02

CONNECTION / 连接

Better together.
让个体成为一群

重复的鲨鱼轮廓由一条珠链串起。温润木纹与冷色金属相遇，独立的小物件形成柔软的连接。

Repeated wooden silhouettes, linked by a single chain. A small study in rhythm, repetition and belonging.

木材金属珠链
03

ENCLOSURE / 容器

A space within.
在方与圆之间

一块木头，两个空间。方形外缘包裹圆形凹槽，旋开的盖子显露内部层次，也让加工的痕迹成为表面语言。

A square outside, a circle within. A pivoting lid reveals the recess and the visible traces of making.

木材凹槽旋转盖
FROM STATICtoSOMETHING ALIVE ↗
04

TEXTURE & MECHANISM / 质感与装置

A softer kind
of shark.柔软的外表，机械的内在

从纤维的缠绕，
到机械的连接。

麻绳包裹鲨鱼形体，木质底座中保留可见的电路、转轴与管线。手工的触感与装置的结构，在同一件作品中并置。

A rope-wrapped body sits above an exposed wooden mechanism. Fibres, wires and tubing bring two very different material languages together.

麻绳木质结构电子元件
TACTILE OUTSIDE.
TECHNICAL INSIDE.

05 / MOTION / 运动

Small shark.
Big personality.

当木头遇上电路，
一个表情有了更多可能。

05

给形状一个表情

几何木片组成夸张的嘴部与三角形牙齿。外露的导线连接 Arduino 与内部元件，让制作的逻辑和角色的表情一起被看见。

Angular wooden planes become an expressive character. Exposed wiring connects the shark to an Arduino, keeping the workings part of the portrait.

AFTER THE MAKING / 制作之后

Thinking
through making.

这份作品集记录了 Fabrication 课程中的五次材料探索。以鲨鱼为线索，观察同一个形态如何在不同结构、尺度和材料里，变成不一样的物件。

A fabrication course portfolio, told through five objects. Each piece is another way of asking what a familiar form can become.
